say:1:1422696101:1.text: The curse—it's broken. I felt the shift and dropped everything the moment I sensed it. I had to see it for myself.
say:1:1422696101:1.source_cn: 想必诅咒已经成功解除了？我在演武场里都感觉到了身上的变...

say:2:1422696102:1.text: We had it under control. You should return and tend to your duties.
say:2:1422696102:1.source_cn: 没有任何需要你赶来的地方，回去处理你的工作。

say:3:1422696103:1.text: How stern, Indris! Can't a concerned citizen pay a visit without being shooed away?
say:3:1422696103:1.source_cn: 真是冷酷无情啊，因度厄，难道你做下了如此壮举，等会儿不...

say:4:1422696104:1.text: You could also take this opportunity to introduce the breathtaking Wilder—pardon me, Scion of the Dark Forest—to the rest of us.
say:4:1422696104:1.source_cn: 还可以顺便把这位美丽的绿裔，我是说薄暮丛林的王子殿下介...

say:5:1422696105:1.text: Please don't refer to me that way...

say:6:1422696106:1.text: Hahaha, apologies, truly. You all looked so grim, I feared Thador's ghost possessed you.
say:6:1422696106:1.source_cn: 哈哈哈，抱歉抱歉，因为你们一直都一副苦大仇深的样子，我...

say:7:1422696107:1.text: Thador is very much alive. He's standing right over there... His guards are still with him!
say:7:1422696107:1.source_cn: 都铎还活着呢，他就站在那边……他的卫兵还陪着他呢！

say:8:1422696108:0.text: Yes, yes. Still crying over that sapling. He didn't even act this way when my mother passed away.
say:8:1422696108:0.source_cn: 是啊，还在那对着个树苗痛哭流涕的，我母亲去世的时候他都...

say:9:1422696109:1.text: But enough of the teasing. I do have something serious to say, though you may not like it.
say:9:1422696109:1.source_cn: 不过，调侃到此为止，我也要说点你或许不爱听的，有点严肃...

say:10:1422696110:1.text: Back when you defeated my mother and left her statue in ruins, I asked you a question, Indris.
say:10:1422696110:1.source_cn: 在你刚刚击败我母亲，这里还留着她那残缺的雕像的时候，我...

say:11:1422696111:1.text: I'm going to ask it again. What kind of future do you intend to lead us toward?
say:11:1422696111:1.source_cn: 在这里，我想重复一遍。因度厄，你想为我们带来怎样的未来呢？

say:12:1422696112:1.text: You've walked the surface and visited Ivoryshade. You've endured Misarte's trials and battled Saida. These twisted histories were all uncovered...
say:12:1422696112:1.source_cn: 踏上地面，前往月影乡，甚至亲自经历了弥萨忒的考验，目睹...

say:13:1422696113:1.text: Now tell me—what do you choose?
say:13:1422696113:1.source_cn: 如今的你，会如何选择呢？

say:14:1422696114:1.text: ... I didn't get the chance to tell you about the Hypogean's deceit. How did you hear of it...?
say:14:1422696114:1.source_cn: ……我记得我还没来得及和你讲恶魔的误导之类的事吧，你到...

say:15:1422696115:1.text: And if you heard our talk just now, does that mean you arrived before we cast the spell?
say:15:1422696115:1.source_cn: 而且，你既然听到我们刚刚的对话了，所以你是从施法之前就...

choice_prompt:16:1422696115.text: And if you heard our talk just now, does that mean you arrived before we cast the spell?
choice_prompt:16:1422696115.source_cn: 而且，你既然听到我们刚刚的对话了，所以你是从施法之前就在这里了？

say:17:1422696116:1.text: I was just concerned for the people's well-being! Such harsh accusations, Merlin.
say:17:1422696116:1.source_cn: 我这是心系民生，别冤枉我！
say:17:1422696116:1.male: I was just concerned for the people's well-being! Such harsh accusations, Merlin.
say:17:1422696116:1.female: I was just concerned for the people's well-being! Such harsh accusations, Merlin.

say:18:1422696117:0.text: Forget it, I'll answer your question.
say:18:1422696117:0.source_cn: 算了，我还是回答你的问题吧。

say:20:1422696118:0.text: My decision has not changed. I believe we should return to the surface.
say:20:1422696118:0.source_cn: 经历了这些，我仍然没有改变自己的想法。我想让大家前往地表。

say:21:1422696119:1.text: Many will find joy in the sunlight with the earth beneath their feet. They'll thrive among flowers and trees, as the Wilders of Ivoryshade do.
say:21:1422696119:1.source_cn: 在这萨洛克兰，一定有很多人会喜欢阳光和大地，也会有很多...

say:22:1422696120:1.text: Like Feli... who barely saw the sun before it was ripped away from him.

say:23:1422696121:1.text: But I understand the meaning behind your question now, Ravion.
say:23:1422696121:1.source_cn: 但，我也同样清楚了，你当年那个问题的潜台词，沙利叶。

say:24:1422696122:1.text: Some will find the surface too bright, too loud, too restless.
say:24:1422696122:1.source_cn: 肯定会有人觉得地表太明亮，太吵闹，没法好好休息。

say:25:1422696123:1.text: The waters may be pure, cold, and gentle—but to some, they'll feel strange.
say:25:1422696123:1.source_cn: 水很清澈，又很冰凉柔软，但肯定也有人讨厌这种单薄透明的感受。

say:26:1422696124:1.text: Some may even resist the instinctual love for greenery, a trait from our Wilder ancestry.
say:26:1422696124:1.source_cn: 或许还会有人会抗拒对于植物的本能喜爱——这种从血脉洋溢...

say:27:1422696125:1.text: And of course... many will remain drawn to the sweet illusions of the Divine Dew.
say:27:1422696125:1.source_cn: 而且，肯定会有更多人，会继续沉迷于灵露带来的，温暖而甜...

say:28:1422696126:1.text: That, too, is part of the work that lies ahead.
say:28:1422696126:1.source_cn: ……那就是我们仍然需要处理的工作了。

say:29:1422696127:0.text: But everything else, I believe, should be a choice given to everyone.
say:29:1422696127:0.source_cn: 但，除此之外的一切，我想，都应该是给予所有人的选择。

say:31:1422696128:0.text: Ah, so let the dreamers chase the sky, and the deep-hearted sink back into their roots?
say:31:1422696128:0.source_cn: 想去地表去地表，想回地底回地底，无论在哪都有一席之地吗？

say:32:1422696129:1.text: I dare say that's the kind of answer even I could raise a toast to.

say:33:1422696130:1.text: The Lucent Tree of the Dark Forest belongs to our distant past.
say:33:1422696130:1.source_cn: 薄暮丛林的流荧树，是我们遥远的过去。

say:34:1422696131:1.text: This sapling before us, it's our beginning.
say:34:1422696131:1.source_cn: 而眼前的这棵树苗，是我们全新的开始。

say:35:1422696132:1.text: ... And it's also the Essail's homeland, the place we'll inevitably look back on when we set off.
say:35:1422696132:1.source_cn: ……也是我们启程时会不禁回顾的，属于我们艾塞勒自己的—...

say:36:1422696133:1.source_cn: 就从现在开始，养育它吧。
